fact: Bank of Namibia Deputy Governor Leonie Dunn said licensing and supervisory responsibilities for payments are being transferred to the central bank under a new Payments Association framework.

The Bank of Namibia said its instant payments solution became operational in June 2026, with live transactions first processed between its Currency Management and Banking Operations Department and Bank Windhoek, Nampost and Letshego Bank Namibia.
The Bank of Namibia is the parent body of Instant Payment Namibia, which operates the Instant Payment Solution; pilot testing in live production is complete and phased rollout is underway.

The Bank of Namibia issued the PSD-1 determination under section 45 of the Payment System Management Act 2023, setting the licensing and authorisation of payment service providers, including electronic money issuers, effective on Gazette publication on 6 January 2026.

The Bank of Namibia's Directive PSDIR-10 of 31 March 2025 orders payment service providers to move low-value cross-border transfers within the Common Monetary Area from the SADC-RTGS arrangement to the TCIB scheme by 1 April 2027.
